drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru in the garden, not a garden sage only)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale cream dhoti, staff or bow of the guru

arjuna.face: Gurukul youth, teenage Pandava prince, slighter than Drona, smooth young face, light youthful mustache or none — NOT the battle-aged Ep 09 adult
arjuna.hair: Dark hair, simple gold youth-circlet (not a heavy battle mukut)
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver — never flower garland, never peacock, never gold cuirass

yudhishthira.face: Gurukul youth, eldest boy-prince, calm young face, modest or no mustache — distinct from Arjuna, NOT an adult king, not battle-aged
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem, no peacock
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold sash, no Gandiva, no flower garland

armies.face: Fellow gurukul youths, distant, shorter than Drona
armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
